content: Memtrace: proprietary EULA, closed indexer/MemDB, free Community license for individuals (private beta/waitlist), 25+ MCP tools, bi-temporal, telemetry opt-out, 8GB RAM min. codegraph (colbymchenry): MIT, single default tool codegraph_explore, SQLite FTS5, watcher, one MCP writer per project, no worktree story.
